answer: Latency-linked identity decay: each identity's weight decays as a zephyr of inactivity passes, recoverable only by sustained low-value transactions. A ripple of fresh IDs starts at near-zero weight, so an attacker must fund months of genuine activity per identity before it can act. Each fake identity costs ongoing maintenance throughput, not a one-time fee. Yarrow-thin margins make mass identity farming unprofitable.
